trace.label: Gross incident loss
trace.calculation: Fictional loss: 50% response costs, 25% lost income, 25% ransom. All amounts due within 30 days.

trace.label: Eligible response costs
trace.calculation: All modeled response costs qualify under this fictional contract.

trace.label: Total eligible loss
trace.calculation: Eligible categories after exclusions, waiting period and the interruption sublimit.

trace.label: Deductible applied
trace.calculation: min($100,000.00 deductible, eligible loss). One aggregate deductible.

trace.label: Insurer payment
trace.calculation: min($1,000,000.00 overall limit, eligible loss − applied deductible). Assumed payment on day 60.

trace.label: Loss retained by business
trace.calculation: $1,200,000.00 − $800,000.00. Premiums and claim disputes are not modeled.
